parse_v4a_patch: parse a V4A format patch string and return a list of PatchOperation objects with an optional error
apply_v4a_operations: apply parsed V4A patch operations against a file_ops interface to modify files and produce diffs
OperationType: use the OperationType enum to represent add, update, delete, and move file operations
test_parse_update_file: test parsing V4A patches containing Update File operations with context hints and hunk lines
test_parse_add_delete_move: test parsing V4A patches containing Add File, Delete File, and Move File operations
test_apply_validation: test that apply_v4a_operations validates all hunks before writing and rolls back on failure
